goal: Run the FormulaLM benchmark only on a remote Linux factory server. Do not run model experiments on the owner's Mac. First verify remote runtime prerequisites: OS is not Darwin, Ollama or equivalent model runtime is available, a Qwen/QW 2.5-compatible model is installed or a documented remote model endpoint is configured, and enough disk/RAM are available. Then run scripts/formulalm_benchmark.py for 6 hours or the maximum safe duration allowed by the node lease policy, writing artifacts under the task artifact directory. Compare baseline local Qwen/QW 2.5 output against the FormulaLM deterministic overlay/kernel. Return JSON/Markdown metrics, blocker list, exact commands, model/runtime version, and recommendation. If prerequisites are missing, do not fake results; return a blocker artifact.
role_goal: prove or falsify FormulaLM improvement with remote-only reproducible benchmarks
acceptance: No experiment runs on macOS or the owner's Mac
Remote server prerequisites are recorded before the benchmark starts
Benchmark artifacts include formulalm-benchmark.json and formulalm-benchmark.md
Metrics compare baseline versus FormulaLM for deterministic estimate tasks
Report clearly separates proven improvements from inconclusive or blocked results

source.rule: remote-only; Mac is control/editing surface only
